import json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import execute_provider as P, execution_spec as S
want = {(p, n) for p in S.PROVIDERS for n in (1,) + tuple(S.PROVIDER_CONTRACTS_V3)}
got = {}
for f in sorted(pathlib.Path('tests/fixtures/golden-argv').glob('*.json')):
    raw = f.read_bytes(); d = json.loads(raw)
    assert raw == (json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) + chr(10)).encode(), f
    assert f.name == '%s-v%d.json' % (d['provider'], d['contract']), f
    assert len(d['cases']) == (2 if d['provider'] == 'codex' else 1), f
    for c in d['cases']:
        assert c['spec']['provider'] == d['provider'] and c['spec'].get('provider_contract_version', 1) == d['contract'], f
        assert P.provider_contract(c['spec'])[0] == c['argv'], f
    got[(d['provider'], d['contract'])] = d
assert set(got) == want, sorted(set(got) ^ want)
first = {2: '8298222', 3: '210d144', 4: '865063c', 5: '0ef0359', 6: 'c598964', 7: '6991b90', 8: '1a37351', 9: 'ed1fa71'}
v1 = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '8298222^'], text=True).strip()
drift = {('claude', 9), ('codex', 9)}
for (p, n), d in got.items():
    assert (d['source_commit'] == v1) if n == 1 else d['source_commit'].startswith(first[n]), (p, n)
    assert len(d['source_commit']) == 40 and d['source'] == ('current-differs-from-historical' if (p, n) in drift else 'historical-equals-current'), (p, n)
R, Q = '/golden/repo', 'GOLDEN PROMPT'
E = 'model_reasoning_effort=' + chr(34) + 'high' + chr(34)
assert got[('codex', 1)]['cases'][0]['argv'] == ['codex', 'exec', '-C', R, '-s', 'workspace-write', '-m', 'gpt-5.5', '-c', E, Q]
assert got[('claude', 1)]['cases'][0]['argv'] == ['claude', '-p', Q, '--model', 'golden-claude', '--effort', 'high', '--allowedTools', 'Read,Write,Edit,Bash']
assert got[('agy', 1)]['cases'][0]['argv'] == ['agy', '--dangerously-skip-permissions', '--print-timeout', '30m', '--model', 'golden-agy-high', '--effort', 'high', '-p', Q]
assert got[('agent', 1)]['cases'][0]['argv'] == ['agent', '-p', '--force', '--trust', '--workspace', R, '--model', 'golden-agent-high[effort=high,fast=false]', Q]
hist = {k: d['historical'] for k, d in got.items() if d['historical']}
assert sorted(hist) == [('claude', 8), ('claude', 9), ('codex', 9)], sorted(hist)
(c8,), (c9,), (x9,) = hist[('claude', 8)], hist[('claude', 9)], hist[('codex', 9)]
assert c8['commit'].startswith('98d628a') and c9['commit'].startswith('ed1fa71') and x9['commit'].startswith('ed1fa71')
assert (c8['accepted_by_adapter'], c9['accepted_by_adapter'], x9['accepted_by_adapter']) == (False, False, True)
assert c8['argv'][c8['argv'].index('--disallowedTools') + 1] == 'Bash(rm -rf *),Bash(git push*),Bash(git reset --hard*),Bash(git checkout -- *),Bash(git clean -f*)'
deny = c9['argv'][c9['argv'].index('--disallowedTools') + 1].split(',')
assert len(deny) == 40 and deny[0] == 'Bash(*rm -rf *)' and deny[-1] == 'Write(.git/config)', len(deny)
assert x9['argv'] == ['codex', 'exec', '--json', '-C', R, '-s', 'workspace-write', '--add-dir', R + '/.git', '-m', 'gpt-5.5', '-c', E, Q]
assert P.argv_sha256(x9['argv']) in P.historical_argv_sha256s(got[('codex', 9)]['cases'][0]['spec'])
for k, e in ((('claude', 8), c8), (('claude', 9), c9)):
    assert e['argv'] != got[k]['cases'][0]['argv'] and P.argv_sha256(e['argv']) not in P.historical_argv_sha256s(got[k]['cases'][0]['spec'])
print('ok')
